title: Bias in the Loop: How Humans Evaluate AI-Generated Suggestions

bias_targets.methodology: Manipulating the task burden by requiring annotators to manually enter the correct value when rejecting an AI pre-annotation, and measuring how this increased effort affects correction, overcorrection, and undercorrection rates.

Manipulating the error rate of the first three AI suggestions (100% correct vs. 100% incorrect) to evaluate whether early exposure anchors users' perceptions and influences subsequent correction behaviors.

Surveying annotators' pre-existing attitudes toward AI and automation, and correlating these psychosocial profiles with their behavioral tendency to either uncritically accept (undercorrect) or overly scrutinize (overcorrect) AI-generated suggestions.
